hypothesis: If weight varies as the cube of linear dimensions during growth, the log-log slope of weight against stature is about 3.
pass_criterion: Across measured children aged 2–18 in NHANES, the OLS slope of ln(weight) on ln(stature), pooled by sex, lies between 2.7 and 3.3 with a 95% CI wholly inside 2.5–3.5.
fail_criterion: The slope lies outside 2.5–3.5, or its point estimate is below 2.5 or above 3.5.
interpretation: 'Weight' is measured body mass and 'linear dimension' is measured stature. 'Tends to vary as the cube' is read as an allometric exponent near 3. 'Not wholly' is allowed by the 2.7–3.3 band. Adolescent body composition changes may pull the exponent below 3.

dataset.name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)
dataset.publisher: US National Center for Health Statistics, CDC
dataset.why_it_fits: Body measures files give measured weight (kg), standing height (cm), age and sex per participant, enough for a log-log regression.
